introduction:
In Madhya Pradesh, the Jati Praman Patra (Caste Certificate) is issued by the Tehsildar / SDM (Sub-Divisional Magistrate) under the Revenue Department for SC, ST, OBC, and EWS applicants.

Citizens can apply online via the MP e-District Portal (mpedistrict.gov.in) or at any Lok Seva Kendra (LSK) / Common Service Centre. Madhya Pradesh guarantees service delivery under the MP Lok Seva Guarantee Act within defined timelines.
quickFacts:
Quick Facts
  • Topic: How to apply for a Caste Certificate (जाति प्रमाण पत्र) online in Madhya Pradesh using a mobile phone.
  • Platform: Madhya Pradesh Lok Seva Guarantee Portal (MP e-District).
  • Eligibility: Must be a resident of Madhya Pradesh. A Samagra ID is mandatory to apply.
  • Fees:
    • Online (Self-applied): Free (₹0).
    • Lok Seva Kendra: ₹20.
    • CSC Center: Approximately ₹60 - ₹150 (varies by center).
  • Timeframe: The official processing time is 30 working days for both rural and urban areas. However, it typically gets generated within 10 to 15 days.
documentsRequired:
Documents Required for Caste Certificate

Note: All documents must be uploaded digitally. Make sure file sizes and formats comply with the portal requirements.
Applicant Info & Photos
  • Samagra ID (Mandatory).
  • Applicant's Photograph: A clear photo under 50KB in size.
  • Educational Certificate: 10th Class Marksheet (to prove educational qualification).
Declarations & Ancestral Proof
  • Declaration Form: A downloaded self-declaration form (घोषणा पत्र) that must be printed, filled out with a blue pen, signed, and scanned/photographed for upload.
  • Previous Caste Certificate Details: If any family member (father, brother, uncle, etc.) already holds a digital caste certificate, their certificate details/registration number will be required.
onlineApplication:
Method 1: Apply Online via Mobile Phone

  1. Step 1: Access the Portal: Open a browser (like Chrome) and search for "MP e District". Go to the official website: mpedistrict.gov.in.
  2. Step 2: Navigate to Services: You can change the language to English for easier navigation. Scroll down to the 'Certificates' section.
  3. Step 3: Select Caste Category: Choose the appropriate option based on your category:
    • 6.3-A: For SC/ST (Scheduled Castes/Scheduled Tribes).
    • 6.3-B: For OBC (Other Backward Classes).
  4. Step 4: Choose Application Mode: Click on the 'Apply' button next to the 'Online' option (which is free).
  5. Step 5: Citizen Registration: If you are a new user, click on 'Registration for New Citizen'. Fill in your Name, Gender, Mobile Number, Email ID, set a Password, enter the captcha, and verify using the OTP sent to your mobile.
  6. Step 6: Login: Once registered, log in using your Mobile Number/Email, Password, and captcha.
  7. Step 7: Start Application: After logging in, go to 'Services' -> 'View More' and select the Caste Certificate service again.
  8. Step 8: Fill the Form:
    • Select whether you are applying for yourself or a family member.
    • Fill in personal details (Name in English and Hindi, Father's/Mother's name, Date of Birth, Religion, Caste, and Sub-caste).
    • Provide your current and permanent address (House number, village/ward, tehsil, district).
    • Indicate if any family member already has a caste certificate and provide their relationship and certificate number if applicable.
  9. Step 9: Upload Documents: Upload your photograph (under 50KB) and the educational qualification proof (10th marksheet).
  10. Step 10: Download and Upload Declaration: In the required documents section, click the link to download the 'Declaration Form' (घोषणा पत्र). Print this form, fill it out manually with a blue pen, sign it, take a photo of it, and upload it back to the portal.
  11. Step 11: Submit: Review all details and click on 'Submit'. Your application will be submitted, and you will receive an application reference number.
offlineApplication:
Method 2: Apply Offline

  • Via Lok Seva Kendra or CSC: Visit your nearest Lok Seva Kendra (Public Service Centre) or Common Service Centre (CSC) with physical copies of your Aadhaar card, Samagra ID, 10th marksheet, photos, and any existing family caste certificate. The operator will fill out the online form on your behalf. A nominal fee (₹20 at Lok Seva, higher at CSCs) will be charged.
  • Via Tehsil Office (Manual): Visit your local Tehsil office. Obtain the physical application form for a caste certificate. Fill it out, attach self-attested photocopies of the required documents (Samagra ID, address proof, ID proof, educational certificates, and family caste proof), and submit it to the designated counter. You will receive an acknowledgment receipt.
afterApplying:
After Applying & Tracking

  • After submitting the application online, it will be forwarded to the respective Sub-Divisional Officer (SDO) or Tehsildar for verification.
  • You can track the status of your application on the MP e-District portal using your application reference number.
  • Once approved (usually within 12 to 15 days), the digitally signed caste certificate will be sent to your registered email address. You can also download it directly from your portal dashboard.
